title: RAID EVENTS: LOCKDOWN ALARM
why: The fifth raid event, the lockdown alarm: blast doors seal a district for 60 seconds with a cache inside, and its machines go berserk. A 25 second warning shows a wide ring with the cache in the middle, so there is time to get in. Then the doors slam and the ring is a wall for a minute: whoever is inside stays inside and whoever is outside stays outside, you included, though bullets still fly over it. The machines inside go berserk, a third faster and a quarter harder, always after you, with a red ring under each, and a garrison is made up to five if the ground held fewer. At 60 seconds the doors open and the berserk machines pour out for 20 seconds more before they calm. The lockdown cache in the middle holds three cache rolls and a jackpot roll, marked on the maps until you open it. DEMO and CAREER work the same.
now: The lockdown alarm event: a sealed district with berserk machines and a jackpot cache for whoever gets it.
